leads.summary: 1 correspondence read side by side: 1 shared wording.

evidence.text: Read side by side in both originals (alignments/hb-quran/08-hb-quran.yaml).
Shared motifs, rarest first: Refuge from the evil of those (women) who blow on knots (al-naffathat fi al-'uqad), i.e. knot-tying sorcery (weight 6.7). Pair score 6.7.

Only in Against the false prophets and the women who hunt souls: False prophets will not be in the council of God's people nor written in the register of the house of Israel; The prophets of Israel are like foxes (jackals) among ruins; Diviners profane God for handfuls of barley and crumbs of bread; False prophets mislead the people saying 'Peace' when there is no peace; The true prophet's task is to go up into the breaches and build a wall for the people on the day of battle; false prophets did not; God tears off the magic bands and lets the trapped souls go free 'like birds' (leporhot); Women prophetesses sew bands (kesatot) on wrists and make veils (mispahot) for heads to hunt souls, killing and keeping alive by magic; Parable: one who builds on the brink of a crumbling bank falls with it into hell; Kings or people practice divination (qesem) and augury (nihush); None more wrong than one who falsely claims revelation or says he can send down the like of God's; Whether a prophet takes payment for his message [contrast between the texts]; False prophets daub a flimsy wall with whitewash (tafel); God's storm, flood-rain and hailstones bring it down; and 3 more.

Only in Sincerity, daybreak and mankind: God's unity and the two refuges: Refuge from the evil of darkness (or the moon) when it settles (ghasiq idha waqab); Refuge from the evil of an envier when he envies (evil eye); God is al-Samad (the Eternal Refuge, the solid one who needs nothing); Triple title: Lord of mankind, King of mankind, God of mankind; Refuge from the evil of the slinking whisperer (al-waswas al-khannas) who whispers in people's breasts, from jinn and humans; God does not beget and was not begotten; God does not beget and was not begotten [contrast between the texts]; Protection from the terror of the night, the arrow by day, the pestilence (dever) stalking in darkness and Qeteb that ravages at noon; Protective formula 'Say: I seek refuge with the Lord of...' (qul a'udhu bi-rabbi) against named evils; Psalm used as protection against demons and harm (later amulet and 'song of plagues'); Cluster of divine epithets in sequence (e.g. the Forgiving, the Loving, Lord of the Throne, the Glorious, doer of what he wills; or Lord, King, God of mankind); 'To whom will you liken God, what likeness compare to him?'; and 2 more.

passages.text: וְאָמַרְתָּ֞ כֹּה אָמַ֣ר אֲדֹנָ֣י יְהוִ֗ה הוֹי֩ לִֽמְתַפְּר֨וֹת כְּסָת֜וֹת עַ֣ל כָּל אַצִּילֵ֣י יָדַ֗י וְעֹשׂ֧וֹת הַמִּסְפָּח֛וֹת עַל רֹ֥אשׁ כָּל קוֹמָ֖ה לְצוֹדֵ֣ד נְפָשׁ֑וֹת הַנְּפָשׁוֹת֙ תְּצוֹדֵ֣דְנָה לְעַמִּ֔י וּנְפָשׁ֖וֹת לָכֶ֥נָה תְחַיֶּֽינָה

לָכֵ֞ן כֹּה אָמַ֣ר אֲדֹנָ֣י יְהוִ֗ה הִנְנִ֤י אֶל כִּסְּתוֹתֵיכֶ֨נָה֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר אַ֠תֵּנָה מְצֹדְד֨וֹת שָׁ֤ם אֶת הַנְּפָשׁוֹת֙ לְפֹ֣רְח֔וֹת וְקָרַעְתִּ֣י אֹתָ֔ם מֵעַ֖ל זְרוֹעֹֽתֵיכֶ֑ם וְשִׁלַּחְתִּי֙ אֶת הַנְּפָשׁ֔וֹת אֲשֶׁ֥ר אַתֶּ֛ם מְצֹדְד֥וֹת אֶת נְפָשִׁ֖ים לְפֹרְחֹֽת

passages.text: (121:1) שִׁ֗יר לַֽמַּ֫עֲל֥וֹת אֶשָּׂ֣א עֵ֭ינַי אֶל הֶהָרִ֑ים מֵ֝אַ֗יִן יָבֹ֥א עֶזְרִֽי (121:2) עֶ֭זְרִי מֵעִ֣ם יְהוָ֑ה עֹ֝שֵׂ֗ה שָׁמַ֥יִם וָאָֽרֶץ (121:3) אַל יִתֵּ֣ן לַמּ֣וֹט רַגְלֶ֑ךָ אַל יָ֝נ֗וּם שֹֽׁמְרֶֽךָ (121:4) הִנֵּ֣ה לֹֽא יָ֭נוּם וְלֹ֣א יִישָׁ֑ן שׁ֝וֹמֵ֗ר יִשְׂרָאֵֽל (121:5) יְהוָ֥ה שֹׁמְרֶ֑ךָ יְהוָ֥ה צִ֝לְּךָ֗ עַל יַ֥ד יְמִינֶֽךָ (121:6) יוֹמָ֗ם הַשֶּׁ֥מֶשׁ לֹֽא יַכֶּ֗כָּה וְיָרֵ֥חַ בַּלָּֽיְלָה (121:7) יְֽהוָ֗ה יִשְׁמָרְךָ֥ מִכָּל רָ֑ע יִ֝שְׁמֹ֗ר אֶת נַפְשֶֽׁךָ (121:8) יְֽהוָ֗ה יִשְׁמָר צֵאתְךָ֥ וּבוֹאֶ֑ךָ מֵֽ֝עַתָּ֗ה וְעַד עוֹלָֽם

sides.note: Protective function implicit in the text; used on childbirth amulets
